classification.difficultyReason: Take both square roots and use exact related angles to find four solutions in the restricted domain.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\sin^2\theta&=\frac34\\\sin\theta&=\pm\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $60^\circ$. Both signs occur, so there is a solution in every quadrant.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=60^\circ,\ 180^\circ-60^\circ,\ 180^\circ+60^\circ,\ 360^\circ-60^\circ\\\theta&=60^\circ,120^\circ,240^\circ,300^\circ\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\tan^2\theta&=1\\\tan\theta&=\pm1\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $45^\circ$. Both signs occur, so there is a solution in every quadrant.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=45^\circ,\ 180^\circ-45^\circ,\ 180^\circ+45^\circ,\ 360^\circ-45^\circ\\\theta&=45^\circ,135^\circ,225^\circ,315^\circ\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\cos^2\theta&=\frac14\\\cos\theta&=\pm\frac12\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $60^\circ$. Both signs occur, so there is a solution in every quadrant.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=60^\circ,\ 180^\circ-60^\circ,\ 180^\circ+60^\circ,\ 360^\circ-60^\circ\\\theta&=60^\circ,120^\circ,240^\circ,300^\circ\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\sin^2\theta&=\frac12\\\sin\theta&=\pm\frac1{\sqrt2}\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $45^\circ$. Both signs occur, so there is a solution in every quadrant.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=45^\circ,\ 180^\circ-45^\circ,\ 180^\circ+45^\circ,\ 360^\circ-45^\circ\\\theta&=45^\circ,135^\circ,225^\circ,315^\circ\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}2\cos^2\theta&=\frac32\\\cos^2\theta&=\frac34\\\cos\theta&=\pm\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $30^\circ$. Both signs occur, so there is a solution in every quadrant.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=30^\circ,\ 180^\circ-30^\circ,\ 180^\circ+30^\circ,\ 360^\circ-30^\circ\\\theta&=30^\circ,150^\circ,210^\circ,330^\circ\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}3\tan^2\theta&=1\\\tan^2\theta&=\frac13\\\tan\theta&=\pm\frac1{\sqrt3}\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $30^\circ$. Both signs occur, so there is a solution in every quadrant.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=30^\circ,\ 180^\circ-30^\circ,\ 180^\circ+30^\circ,\ 360^\circ-30^\circ\\\theta&=30^\circ,150^\circ,210^\circ,330^\circ\end{align*}$$
